description: Tsanas and Xifara publish 768 building-energy simulation cases for predicting heating and cooling loads. Twelve basic building shapes were simulated in Ecotect with changes to glazing, orientation and other characteristics. Eight predictors describe compactness, surface and wall or roof areas, overall height, orientation and glazing; two targets describe heating and cooling load. Coverage is synthetic building configurations, with no site or calendar period established by the inspected landing page. UCI provides an XLSX workbook free under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is that target units and the detailed weather or occupancy assumptions are not given in its variable table, so load magnitudes require source-method checks before physical reuse. Simulation uses include testing surrogate models and comparing sensitivity to building geometry within the original experiment. It complements model-energyplus, a separate building simulation engine, without claiming the two use identical assumptions. The provider identifies a 2012 Energy and Buildings paper. No workbook was downloaded or Ecotect simulation rerun.
